title: " 12 " + 1 is 13: spaces around the digits are ignored in text converted to a number

source.quote: the string is automatically converted into a corresponding number, as long as the string is a valid representation of a number
source.supports: text in an arithmetic expression converts when it is a valid number; the page does not say which forms are valid

source.quote: DAX implicitly converts the string to a number, and then does the addition for a numeric result

derivation: + converts text to a number when the text is a valid representation of a number. Spaces before and after the digits are taken as insignificant: 12 + 1 = 13.
alternative: No source says whether surrounding spaces are accepted. If they are not, the conversion fails and the query returns an error.
notes: The column's type is not asserted.
